title: Principal Islamic beliefs
log: 2026-10-29T12:14:28Z write: the API refused it in the chapter request, so it is written on its own next

draft.title: Principal Islamic beliefs
card: Muslims believe in one God, called Allah. Allah is the creator of all things, and no one and nothing is equal to Allah.
Muslims also believe in angels, who are God's servants. They believe God sent prophets to guide people, and that Muhammad was the last of them.
Muslims believe God revealed books to guide people. The Quran is the final one, given to Muhammad.
Muslims believe in the Day of Judgement, when every person is held to account for their life. They also believe in God's decree: God knows and has power over all that happens.
draft.remember: Islamic belief rests on one God, who sends angels, prophets and books, and who will judge all people.

a.q: Which belief do Muslims hold about Muhammad?
opts: He was the last of the prophets sent by God
He was the first of the prophets sent by God
He was an angel who carried God's messages
He was a prophet who is equal to God
a.why: Muslims believe God sent many prophets and that Muhammad was the last. The belief in one God means no one is equal to Allah, so Muhammad is not equal to God. Muhammad is a human prophet, not an angel.
a.clue: Think about where Muhammad comes in the line of prophets.

b.q: Amira is a Muslim. She says that everyone will be held to account for their life after death. Which belief is she describing?
b.why: The Day of Judgement is the belief that every person is held to account for their life. God's decree is a different belief, about God's knowledge and power over all that happens. It is not about accounting for a life.
b.clue: Which belief is about people being held to account?

a.best: He was the last of the prophets sent by God
